text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text: —Alright then! To celebrate our long-awaited soccer match viewing and okonomiyaki party with Dantsu-chan's family!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu & Mirako
text_block_list.text: —Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Haa~! What a wonderful day it's been~.
Our favorite club won, so I'm in the absolute best mood♪
...Did you have fun, Dantsu-chan?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yes! So much...! The cheers, the uproar when they scored a goal—I got goosebumps!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: It's got a different kind of fun compared to races, you know? Like the excitement of the match not being decided in an instant~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Or rather, this whole situation might be interesting in itself? Who knew we'd end up hanging out as whole families on a day off~.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu's Mother
text_block_list.text: Fufu, truly. Who would have thought the day would come when we'd spend time like this with someone she met at Tracen Academy?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu's Father
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
...At first, we were so worried about whether she'd be able to manage at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"A-Amazing... that girl, and that girl too...
Everyone is so famous from junior races...
Dantsu-chan, if things ever get too tough—"

text_block_list.name: Newly Enrolled Dantsu
text_block_list.text:
"...Gh. I-I'll be fine!
I'm going to give it my all... more than anyone!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu's Mother
text_block_list.text: Right, right. We were so worried back then that we ended up calling constantly... But one day—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Dantsu-chaaan, let's skip personal training today and get some ice cr—wait, ah! Are you on the phone?!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"A-Ah, n-nice to meet you! ...Um~
This is, well, because she worked super hard today, and she's usually much more disciplined..."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu. Mirako-senpai!
...Since she invited me, maybe I'll take a break from personal training today—alright, talk to you later, Mom!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu's Father
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes. And after that, every time she called, she'd excitedly tell us, "Mirako-senpai did this today~"—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Eh?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah! Dad, stop!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Speaking of which, so did our girl! She called us for once, worrying, "What if she's super strict and scary~?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text: But a few weeks later, she was cheerfully calling us saying, "My underclassman is just so adorable"—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah! Confidentiality! That's a breach of privacy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle's Parents
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, don't be embarrassed, don't be embarrassed~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Aaaah, geez! Outside! It's too hot in here, I'm going outside!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: M-Me too...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—Good grief.
Our parents are always blurting out unnecessary things~.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I really wish they'd talked about that while we weren't around...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Um... But it's true that I'm really glad my roommate senpai was Mirako-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Working hard together...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: And not pushing ourselves together too...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I truly feel from the bottom of my heart that I've been able to keep going thanks to "Mirako-senpai Therapy".

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Pfft. Therapy from me? What's that about~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: But yeah... I kinda get it. I'm comforted and healed by Dantsu-chan every day too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Uh oh. I might not be able to get by without "Dantsu-chan Therapy" anymore.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Ehehehe!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Haaa.
You're so comforting to be around, Mirako-senpai.
Evening. While passing by the school gates...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Uwaah, this is bad~. I smell like okonomiyaki all over!
I gotta take a bath as soon as we get back~.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, me too!
Shall we take our time and relax in the large bath?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm all for it~. Let's hurry and change into the matching
loungerwear we got from our moms~♪
choice_data_list: Heh, you two get along so well~
Fufu, you two get along so well~

text_block_list.text:
Seeing them leisurely walking side by side
somehow warmed my heart.
